title: Pack
description: An adventure pack's manifest: which ruleset it targets and which maps it holds. See docs/design/board.md.

version.description: Semantic version; a save records the version it was played with.

ruleset.description: The ruleset the pack targets, e.g. pf2e.

effects.description: The pack's visual effects file (default effects.json, if present): {palette, effects, fallbacks} in the ruleset library's form (rulesets/<id>/effects.js). Adds effects and restyles the ruleset's.

content.description: Open content this pack's campaigns use, from content/ in the repository (pf2e/pathfinder-monster-core). The pack's own content (its content/ folder) overrides it.

party_level.description: The party's expected level where it meets each map or subsystem ({default, <map or subsystem id>}). A check the book gives no DC for takes the game system's DC for that level (tools/advimport/dcfill.mjs).
